editorial:
Imagine being stuck between a scary mob boss and a wild animal in the middle of the Australian Outback. That is exactly what happens to these two best friends from New York. One is a hair stylist and the other wants to be a rock star, but neither of them is very good at handling crime. They are forced to fly across the world to deliver a bag of cash, but a sneaky kangaroo steals the money and runs off. It is a silly, lighthearted ride that feels like a classic early 2000s comedy where everything that can go wrong actually does.

You will probably love the funny chemistry between the leads and the chaos of the chase scenes. While the plot is pretty simple and some of the jokes are a bit cheesy, it is a great way to turn your brain off for a couple of hours. If you are looking for something easy to watch with the family, you should definitely check it out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality for those bright Australian landscapes.
endingExplained: After a wild chase, the guys finally get the money back from the kangaroo. They use the cash to pay off the mob boss so they can finally be free. In the end, the kangaroo becomes a local celebrity and the friends head back to New York. They learned their lesson about getting mixed up in crime, and everyone ends up happy and safe after a lot of crazy adventures.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly comedies and animal adventures
